plan: [This is a sealed-bid second-price auction with three independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid = value = 34) is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected payoff regardless of others. Bidding 34 means I win exactly when the second-highest bid is below 34 and I pay that second-highest bid; misreporting cannot increase expected profit. Values are iid and there's no prior history to update. Therefore submit my true value as the bid.]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected surplus regardless of others. There is no prior history to update beliefs and values are redrawn each round, so truth-telling maximizes long-run profit. I will therefore bid my valuation of $47.]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values and one round. Truthful bidding is a weakly dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit. No informative history is available. I will bid my true value of $41. Ties are resolved randomly; bidding truthfully remains optimal.]
